_comment: Advisory sleeve/theme comfort targets for rotation OVERWEIGHT detection. A theme whose portfolio look-through pct exceeds its target is flagged overweight; the excess (in % and $) seeds an advisory trim RANGE. A theme below its floor is flagged underweight (a redeploy gap). Targets are operator comfort lines, NOT a model output — edit freely. Advisory only; nothing is ever placed.

trim_band._note: advisory trim of a position = 5-15% of its value, capped at the sleeve excess; operator confirms
